name: valve_cs2_01
title: Valve, Counter-Strike 2
description: The official music kit of Counter-Strike 2.

name: danielsadowski_01
title: Daniel Sadowski, Crimson Assault
description: Video Game Composer Daniel Sadowski delivers Edgy Action mixed with CRAZY FAT beats in this pulsating, exhilarating Music Pack.

name: noisia_01
title: Noisia, Sharpened
description: Dutch Electronic Trio Noisia brings a tough, cinematic feel with a unique blend of tradition and progression.

name: robertallaire_01
title: Robert Allaire, Insurgency
description: Music to crush your enemies see them driven before you from award winning composer Robert Allaire.

name: seanmurray_01
title: Sean Murray, A*D*8
description: From the composer of two of the world's biggest war games, comes a sonic loadout that will bring your enemies to Hell's Gate!!

name: feedme_01
title: Feed Me, High Noon
description: Renowned elecronic musician Feed Me, brings a western corral showdown into a modern electronic space.

name: dren_01
title: Dren, Death's Head Demolition
description: From game music composer Dren, this cinematic, superhero-metal inspired music pack puts the 'ill' into KILL!

name: austinwintory_01
title: Austin Wintory, Desert Fire
description: Grammy nominated game composer Austin Wintory asks, why bother hunting your enemies when you can lure them in with a deadly, admittedly insane, tango?

name: sasha_01
title: Sasha, LNOE
description: Immerse yourself in this cinematic soundtrack full of soaring strings, pulsating melodies and driving drums from the world renowned DJ / Producer Sasha

name: skog_01
title: Skog, Metal
description: A lesson in aggression from Metal producer, Skog.

name: midnightriders_01
title: Midnight Riders, All I Want for Christmas
description:
"HAPPY HOLIDAYS, ****ERS!"
    -Midnight Riders

name: mattlange_01
title: Matt Lange, IsoRhythm
description: Indulge your aural senses in a collection of cinematic, glitchy atmospheres and hard-hitting throbbing rhythms by electronic producer and innovator Matt Lange.

name: mateomessina_01
title: Mateo Messina, For No Mankind
description: Own your enemies. Pure intensity by Grammy winning composer, Mateo Messina.

name: hotlinemiami_01
title: Various Artists, Hotline Miami
description: A multitude of electronic artists deliver brutal beats in this exhilarating Music Pack from the iconic Hotline Miami.

name: danielsadowski_02
title: Daniel Sadowski, Total Domination
description: Composer Daniel Sadowski raises the bar with aggressive electronic beats, creative sound fx and an exhilerating, driving, futuristic vibe. "Warning: Will cause a rise in adrenaline!"

name: damjanmravunac_01
title: Damjan Mravunac, The Talos Principle
description: Composer Damjan Mravunac blends energetic cinematic grooves with epic choirs in this music pack featuring music from Croteam's critically acclaimed title "The Talos Principle".

name: proxy_01
title: Proxy, Battlepack
description: Russian Heavy Electronica Artist PROXY brings his own Unique heavy artillery to Counter Strike. Hybrid audio Weaponry fused with the finest studio technology makes this pack unique.

name: kitheory_01
title: Ki:Theory, MOLOTOV
description: Recording artist and DOTA TI4 performer, Ki:Theory drops BOMBS with this searing set of razor edge dark electronic rock.

name: troelsfolmann_01
title: Troels Folmann, Uber Blasto Phone
description: Triumphant Blastophones combine with contemporary Uberpulse in this explosive collection by ultra award winning composer Troels Folmann.

name: kellybailey_01
title: Kelly Bailey, Hazardous Environments
description: Kelly Bailey, composer of Valve's Half-Life series, creates an arsenal of apocalyptic new music inspired by the darker side of the Half-Life universe.

name: skog_02
title: Skog, II-Headshot
description: Metal composer and producer Jocke Skog returns with an all new, hard hitting metal kit, turning the rest of the CS:GO Music Kits into something cute, warm and fuzzy. Now go become MVP so everyone can hear your awesomeness!

name: danielsadowski_03
title: Daniel Sadowski, The 8-Bit Kit
description: Daniel Sadowski creates the first ever 8-bit Music Kit for Counter-Strike complete with authentic 8-bit sounds.

name: awolnation_01
title: AWOLNATION, I Am
description: AWOLNATION Alternative Rocker AWOLNATION brings you a music kit for the ages. This kit is jam-packed with an eclectic selection of tunes and includes cuts from singles 'I Am' and multi-platinum hit 'Sail'.

name: mordfustang_01
title: Mord Fustang, Diamonds
description: Diamonds. They are forever. Dive into the arpeggiotron of Mord Fustang with this fresh set of grooves and atmospheres.

name: michaelbross_01
title: Michael Bross, Invasion!
description: Michael Bross conjures epic / cinematic techno-grunge to make you feel like a true badass in battle.

name: ianhultquist_01
title: Ian Hultquist, Lion's Mouth
description: Mixing pulsating strings and synths with pounding war drums, prepare yourself for battle with this thunderous soundtrack from composer Ian Hultquist.

name: newbeatfund_01
title: New Beat Fund, Sponge Fingerz
description: Sunny surf rock with elements of hip-hop, punk and garage pop. Keep it real and get headshots.

name: beartooth_01
title: Beartooth, Disgusting
description: Beartooth brings an agressive back-to-basics hardcore stomp that gets crowds moving and breaking stuff. A perfect soundtrack for your no-scope scout frags. Rock 'till you're dead.

name: lenniemoore_01
title: Lennie Moore, Java Havana Funkaloo
description: Game Composer Lennie Moore serves an aromatic, spicy blend of Jazzy Funk. Delicious when served cold, like the corpses of your enemies after you're done with them.

name: darude_01
title: Darude, Moments CSGO
description: Yield freely in the soundscapes of Finnish producer Darude's familiar musical flavours and tones. Enriching yourself with access to a heavy fusion of progressive overtones and scores of tingling melodic structure from the sounds banks of one of dance music's most renowned pioneers.

name: theverkkars_01
title: The Verkkars, EZ4ENCE
description: The Verkkars rise through the Finnish charts with a heart-pounding tribute to ENCE. Can it really be so EZ?

name: halo_01
title: Halo, The Master Chief Collection
description: Give your Counter Strike auditory experience a legendary makeover with the Master Chief Collection Music Pack, featuring iconic musical moments from the Halo universe. © 2019 343 Industries. All rights reserved. Used with permission from 343 Industries. Halo: The Master Chief Collection and the Halo logo are trademarks of the Microsoft group of companies.

name: scarlxrd_01
title: Scarlxrd: King, Scar
description: Scarlxrd blends heavy trap beats with a flow and delivery that creates his own unique subgenre. With this exciting blend his live shows capture the attention of everyone in the crowd.

name: hlalyx_01
title: Half-Life: Alyx, Anti-Citizen
description: This music kit commemorates Half-Life: Alyx, Valve's VR return to the Half-Life series. You are humanity's only chance for survival, and your immersive environmental interactions continue in Counter-Strike: Global Offensive.

name: amontobin_01
title: Amon Tobin, All for Dust
description: Legendary producer Amon Tobin lends his unique aesthetic to CS:GO. This time through tube amplifiers.

name: hades_01
title: Darren Korb, Hades Music Kit
description: Sure, you might miss a shot from time to time, but what never misses is this blood-pumping Music Kit straight from the Underworld of Hades, Supergiant's rogue-like dungeon crawler.

name: neckdeep_02
title: Neck Deep, The Lowlife Pack
description: Prove you are not a normie (and better than everyone else on the map) with Neck Deep's new music kit, which includes songs from the band's album All Distortions Are Intentional.

name: scarlxrd_02
title: Scarlxrd, CHAIN$AW.LXADXUT.
description: CHAIN$AW BRINGS SCARLXRD AT HIS UNPRECENDENTED BEST WITH A RAW FLOW AND A HEAVY TRACK TO MATCH.

name: bbnos_01
title: bbno$, u mad!
description: bbno$ formulates 'the' toxic gamer anthem, u mad! Are u mad? LOL get good scrub. Research shows if you play with this Music Kit equipped you'll immediately go from Silver to Global.

name: theverkkars_02
title: The Verkkars & n0thing, Flashbang Dance
description: From sunny California to frigid Lapland, Counter-Strike legend n0thing and The Verkkars combine powers to create the smash hit, Flashbang Dance! 3, 2, 1 you’re blind!

name: perfectworld_01
title: Perfect World, 花脸 Hua Lian (Painted Face)
description: Celebrate the 5th anniversary of CS:GO's release in China with a one of a kind music kit, 花脸 Hua Lian (Painted Face). This kit combines folk Qinqiang opera (the earliest Chinese style Rock 'n' Roll) and modern Rock 'n' Roll. Whether you are engulfed in smoke or blinded by a flashbang, don't get lost!

name: denzelcurry_01
title: Denzel Curry, ULTIMATE
description: Denzel brings his signature energy to CS:GO as he traverses trap, jazz, and drum and bass beats. This kit features Denzel's hits "Walkin", "ULTIMATE", and more, so break out the nickel-plated chrome Berettas and crank up the intensity with the ULTIMATE music kit.

name: valve_01
title: Valve, CS:GO
description: The default CS:GO music kit, introduced with the launch of CS:GO in 2012.

name: beartooth_02
title: Beartooth, Aggressive
description: Beartooth is back for round two. This new music kit hits harder and is even more aggressive. We've also made the MVP anthem extra heavy so your opponents feel really bad after they've lost to you.

name: blitzkids_01
title: Blitz Kids, The Good Youth
description: British Pop/Punk band Blitz Kids brings you the perfect music kit for rushing B while thinking about those night drives you had with your friends in High School. This kit is for going fast and feeling young.

name: hundredth_01
title: Hundredth, FREE
description: Hundredth is bringing heavy to the world with their unique take on melodic hardcore. Break free or return to Dust with this perfect soundtrack for fragging the unworthy.

name: neckdeep_01
title: Neck Deep, Life's Not Out To Get You
song: Life's Not Out To Get You
description: Sometimes you just need some Pop Punk to get you through the day. Whether it is dealing with campers or losing a massive kill streak, Neck Deep is here to prove that Life's Not Out To Get You, but the other team still is.

name: roam_01
title: Roam, Backbone
description: Roam delivers fast, straight-forward Pop Punk that gets crowd and players alike moving. Prove you have a Backbone with this perfect soundtrack for rushing in and obliterating the other team before they even realize they're deadweight.

name: twinatlantic_01
title: Twin Atlantic, GLA
description: Heavier, rowdier, and louder than ever, Twin Atlantic comes to CS:GO ready to help you melt the faces with the firepower of Scottish rock.

name: skog_03
title: Skog, III-Arena
description: Skog is back with a third crushing metal kit. This time with an electro-organic twist to the music, combining massive guitar riffs with equally massive drops, loop elements and drones.

name: austinwintory_02
title: Austin Wintory, Bachram
description: Austin Wintory mixes Celtic fantasy with sizzling electronics and a generous helping of Peter Hollens' vocals in this genre-bending Music Kit.

name: dren_02
title: Dren, Gunman Taco Truck
description: The apocalyptic mariachi soundtrack from the indie game hit, Gunman Taco Truck, comes to CS:GO with intense Mexican flavored tunes like Pollo Diablo and Persecución de Helltain!

name: danielsadowski_04
title: Daniel Sadowski, Eye of the Dragon
description: From the composer who brought you "Total Domination", "The 8-Bit Kit" and "Crimson Assault", comes "Eye Of The Dragon". Music composer Daniel Sadowski mixes Ninjas + Guns + Hip-Hop + Techno to create an action-packed Music Kit. Ninjas are known for their fast and precise attacks, yet they can be invisible to their enemy.

name: treeadams_benbromfield_01
title: Tree Adams and Ben Bromfield, M.U.D.D. FORCE
description: Alchemists of a powerful chaos that is M.U.D.D. FORCE - composers Tree Adams and Ben Bromfield weld epic battle motifs and grinding synths into a Maelstrom of full throttle destruction.

name: timhuling_01
title: Tim Huling, Neo Noir
description: Composer Tim Huling delivers classic film-noir style tracks blended with contemporary grooves and beats.

name: sammarshall_01
title: Sam Marshall, Bodacious
description: Inspired by the funky video game music of the early 90s, composer Sam Marshall cooks up some classic game nostalgia with a spicy modern sauce.

name: mattlevine_01
title: Matt Levine, Drifter
description: Composer Matt Levine delivers raw swagger in this gritty homage to the Spaghetti Western. It has never felt better to say, "go ahead, make my day..."

name: austinwintory_03
title: Austin Wintory, Mocha Petal
description: Austin Wintory answers the question humanity has asked for ages: what happens if you merge beer garden accordion polka music with grungy heavy metal?

name: chipzel_01
title: Chipzel, ~Yellow Magic~
description: Video game composer and chiptune legend Chipzel brings a glitchy Speak & Spell inspired mashup of hybrid styles packed with fun, funk and flavour.

name: freakydna_01
title: Freaky DNA, Vici
description: Opera. 8-bit sounds. Analogue synths. What's not to love? Chiptune specialist Freaky DNA and soprano Leanne Koch team up for some heavy beats and good times!

name: jesseharlin_01
title: Jesse Harlin, Astro Bellum
description: Composer Jesse Harlin delivers bombastic space opera drama inspired by classic sci-fi of the 70s, 80s, and beyond.

name: laurashigihara_01
title: Laura Shigihara: Work Hard, Play Hard
description: Video game composer and developer Laura Shigihara will help you tell everyone loudly and proudly that you're the MVP. Have fun with this unique blend of 90s dance, retro video game synth, and just a hint of Plants vs. Zombies.

name: sarahschachner_01
title: Sarah Schachner, KOLIBRI
description: Brought to you by Sarah Schachner, a dystopian goth choir of self-aware, Scandinavian robots decide that humanity must be eliminated.

name: 3kliksphilip_01
title: 3kliksphilip, Heading for the Source
description: On a quest to go pro, or unintentionally going low? Let this kit’s 80’s synths and dreamy melodies take you back. Back, back, back... to the good old days.

name: hlb_01
title: Humanity's Last Breath, Void
description: Swedish Band Humanity's Last Breath drops in heavy with their Void Music Kit. Pounding drums, colossal riffs and an atmosphere to send shivers up your spine.

name: juelz_01
title: Juelz, Shooters
description: Neo trap synths, gritty 808s, an epic piano riff, and a plethora of gunfire sound effects. The OG trap anthem "Shooters" by Juelz makes for a truly elite Music Kit. Suitable for MVPs only.

name: knock2_01
title: Knock2, dashstar*
description: dashstar*, the iconic bass house anthem from Knock2, provides non-stop energy that captures the young San Diego native’s mantra, "no limit".

name: meechydarko_01
title: Meechy Darko, Gothic Luxury
description: Grab a Glock and equip this music kit to be transported to the center of New York's underground hip-hop scene.

name: sullivanking_01
title: Sullivan King, Lock Me Up
description: Love the chase? Love the hunt? Hard rock, metal, and dubstep collide in Sullivan King's soundtrack for becoming unstoppable.

name: dryden_01
title: DRYDEN, Feel The Power
description: What else needs to be said? Feel The Power. Lock in with this high-energy electro Music Kit from DRYDEN.

name: isoxo_01
title: ISOxo, inhuman
description: Made especially for those games when you feel... different. Haunt your enemies round after round with the "inhuman" Music Kit from ISOxo.

name: killscript_01
title: KILL SCRIPT, All Night
description: Are you a lover or a fighter? Perhaps both? Let the entire lobby know with the "All Night" Music Kit from KILL SCRIPT.

name: knock2_02
title: Knock2, Make U SWEAT!
description: For players who treat every game like it's a Major Grand Final, even when there's only a few hundred CSR on the line. Bring the energy and the wins with Knock2's second Music Kit, "Make U SWEAT!".

name: radcat_01
title: Rad Cat, Reason
description: Sometimes defusing the bomb is enough to be the round MVP. Celebrate every moment—big or small—with the "Reason" Music Kit from Rad Cat.

name: twerl_01
title: TWERL and Ekko & Sidetrack, Under Bright Lights
description: There's no better time to come alive than when in the spotlight. Let the drum and bass anthem "Under Bright Lights" by TWERL and Ekko & Sidetrack carry you and your team to new heights.

name: austinwintory_04
title: Austin Wintory, The Devil Went Clubbing in Georgia
song: The Devil Went Clubbing in Georgia
description: Austin Wintory makes a deal with Satan, smashing together devilish fiddle music with full-on EDM club vibes.

name: benbromfield_01
title: Ben Bromfield, Rabbit Hole
description: You've been double-crossed! Experience this high-stakes, broodingly tense, jazz-inspired soundtrack from film & TV composer Ben Bromfield as you uncover just how deep this rabbit hole goes...

name: danielsadowski_05
title: Daniel Sadowski, Dead Shot
description: Daniel Sadowski invites players to enter the world of "Dead Shot", a hybrid blend of action, hip-hop, orchestral, electronic, retro, emotion, and sound design. Avoid the Head Rot!

name: dren_03
title: Dren McDonald, Coffee! Kofe! Kahveh!
description: Caffeine is your friend. It's everybody's friend, except for your enemy! "Coffee! Kofe! Kahveh!" is BalkanBalkanBalkan! street party brass music from Dren Mcdonald ("Gunman Taco Truck" and "Death’s Head Demolition") recorded live in Balkancisco!

name: mattlevine_02
title: Matt Levine, Agency
description: Enter the dangerous world of espionage with the "Agency" music kit from composer Matt Levine.

name: sammarshall_02
title: Sam Marshall, Clutch
description: "Clutch", the unsanctioned sequel to "Bodacious", is a cyber-funk, fever dream abomination reanimated by Sam Marshall through alchemy and arcane ritual.

name: timhuling_02
title: Tim Huling, Devil's Paintbrush
description: Get your adrenaline up with "Devil's Paintbrush" from Tim Huling, a high-energy groove-metal experience.

name: treeadams_01
title: Tree Adams, Seventh Moon
description: Here on "Seventh Moon", Tree Adams rolls up a greasy mix of intergalactic funk with a driving battle score.

name: perfectworld_02
title: Perfect World, Ay Hey
description: Merging traditional Chinese folk and electronic music, "Ay Hey" offers vivid storytelling and energetic beats to connect players of different ages and backgrounds. With its lively rhythm matching players' enthusiasm for the game, "Ay Hey" vividly captures various humorous and playful battle scenes.

name: adambeyer_01
title: Adam Beyer, Red Room
description: Swedish techno legend Adam Beyer brings you this dreamy belter of a music kit to help paint your enemies red.

name: ghost_01
title: Ghost, Skeletá
description: MESSAGE FROM THE CLERGY—Papa V Perpetua has descended on Counter-Strike in a glorious heavy metal spectacle. Escape the travails of daily life as you spray and pray to the Unholy See.

name: health_01
title: HEALTH, RAT WARS
description: Experience HEALTH in Counter-Strike. Take up arms and enjoy the brutal and punishing industrial metal sound of RAT WARS.

name: jamesandthecoldgun_01
title: James and the Cold Gun, Chewing Glass
description: Welsh rock duo James and the Cold Gun unleash pure, unfiltered energy, blending classic punk attitude with modern alt-rock fire to create a blistering music kit.

name: jonathanyoung_01
title: Jonathan Young, Starship Velociraptor
description: Space-Pirate Power Metal is what your game is missing. Take a ride on the Starship Velociraptor and let the sounds of Jonathan Young's anime and video game inspired album bring your matches to another level.

name: juelz_02
title: Juelz, Floorspace
description: Need Floorspace? This massive music kit from Juelz’s debut album contains neo-rave synths, gritty bass lines, and hard hitting trap drums. Floorspace has been reimagined for Counter-Strike 2, and the MVP anthem “Gossip” makes players want to set up—then drop—an LED wall.

name: killermike_01
title: Killer Mike, MICHAEL
description: Enjoy the 3x GRAMMY Award winning hip-hop album in the world of Counter-Strike. Killer Mike's voice will help keep you motivated as you rise through the ranks and improve your skills.

name: pvris_01
title: PVRIS, Evergreen
description: The only thing we love more than a good enemy? A good soundtrack. Let the new PVRIS music kit hype up your team and keep your victory streak Evergreen.

name: selectiveresponse_01
title: Selective Response, No Love Only Pleasure
description: Drive your desires with this dynamic, high-energy music kit from American techno icon Selective Response. Charged up and ready for action.

name: tigercub_01
title: Tigercub, The Perfume of Decay
description: UK rock outfit Tigercub delivers a gritty melodic punch, fusing raw alt-rock intensity with a brooding modern edge to create a crushing music kit.

name: alrt_01
title: ALRT, DOPAMINE HIT
description: ALRT's bouncy bass house record delivers the ultimate "DOPAMINE HIT", keeping you locked in and ready to rise to the occasion when it matters most.

name: altare_01
title: Altare, Change My Mind
description: Altare's euphoric wave anthem "Change My Mind" is perfect for the highest of highs when it feels like nobody can stand in your way.

name: borne_01
title: borne, Give It To Me
description: borne's gritty bass banger "Give It To Me" will have players ready to give it to their opponents in Counter-Strike, and beyond.

name: pirapus_01
title: Pirapus, EVERYNITE
description: Pirapus' high octane drum and bass anthem "EVERYNITE" evokes the feeling of being on the edge of greatness. True to its name, this one ensures you're locked in every night.

name: repiet_01
title: Repiet & Julia Kleijn, On And On
description: Be prepared for any challenge with Repiet and Julia Kleijn's infectious track "On And On." Through the highs and the lows, it's a tune that sets the tone to attack any obstacle.

name: shockone_01
title: ShockOne, Voices
description: Break free with ShockOne's high energy drum and bass record "Voices." Primed for delivering in the clutch, this music kit features punchy bass lines that will carry you to many MVPs.

name: starjunk95_01
title: Starjunk 95, Industrial Sunset Memories
description: Experience a music kit from the grooviest station in the galaxy, featuring the newest sounds of today drenched with vintage nostalgia of yesterday. This is Starjunk 95.

name: alleycvt_01
title: ALLEYCVT & LEVEL UP, BELIEVE
description: ALLEYCVT and LEVEL UP join forces on "BELIEVE", a relentless bass record with drops heavy enough to shake the whole server.

name: arcando_01
title: Arcando & Pirapus, Ultrasound
description: From Arcando and Pirapus, "Ultrasound" is a high velocity drum and bass anthem that keeps the pressure on from first contact to final kill.

name: djdiesel_01
title: DJ DIESEL & Hairitage, BANG YOUR HEAD
description: When DJ DIESEL, AKA Shaquille O'Neal, links up with bass heavyweight Hairitage, the result is "BANG YOUR HEAD", a dubstep banger made for headshots.

name: fool_01
title: F.O.O.L, Criminals
description: T-side finally has a theme song. Dark, cinematic, and full of synthwave, F.O.O.L's "Criminals" provides a score for every execute.

name: noisestorm_01
title: Noisestorm, Crab Rave
description: Released on April Fools' Day 2018, Noisestorm's "Crab Rave" scuttled its way into internet legend. Win the round and spread the news; the enemy team is gone.

name: pegboardnerds_01
title: Pegboard Nerds, Disconnected
description: A Monstercat classic, Pegboard Nerds' "Disconnected" has been short-circuiting speakers for over a decade. This time, it's the other team disconnecting.

name: tristam_braken_01
title: Tristam & Braken, Flight
description: Tristam & Braken's "Flight" is pure nostalgia that sounds just as good today as when it originally released in 2013.

name: vicetone_01
title: Vicetone & Cozi Zuehlsdorff, Nevada
description: Some songs take you right back, and Vicetone's "Nevada" is a dose of 2016, best enjoyed celebrating a victory.
